title: Mirage: Escalating Exposure + Superior Cooldown right after Ricochet vs the gun run
question: At ~28.8k, is the spirit order (Ricochet, Escalating Exposure, Superior Cooldown) stronger than the gun order (Headhunter, Titanic, Ricochet, Spirit Rend)?
hypothesis: 5-mark pop = 16 x (31 + 0.35 x spirit) ~990 at 88 spirit; EE at 12 stacks (Toxic bleed ticks every 0.5s) adds +54% to it, Superior Cooldown + invest +21 spirit. Gun order adds Headhunter ~20 DPS and Titanic ~+15 sustained DPS. Prediction: time to kill a 3000 HP target and 3-target damage in 20s both >=10% better on spirit arm.
controls: Cooldowns, HP, leech stacks reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/imbue under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
procedure: Shoot the main target, pop marks at 5 stacks, Dust Devil + Scarabs on cooldown
Run 2: 3 grouped targets, record total damage in 20s

decision.rule: SUPPORTS spirit_order if TTK >=10% lower with non-overlapping ranges
